### `og.load.emitter`

A particle emitter asset for ParticleSystem.emitter, from a cooked `.ogt` of `type particles`: shape, rate and bursts, lifetime, speed, size and colour over life, gravity, drag, noise, a texture and sprite sheet, blending, collision (`collision <bounce> <friction> [depth | colliders]`: off the drawn depth, or off the scene's colliders on the GPU), billboard, mesh (`render mesh box | sphere | tetrahedron | "<model id>"`: each particle a small lit shape that tumbles with its rotation) or 2D sprite rendering, `lit true` (billboards and meshes shaded by the sun, the sky and local lights), `distortion <0..1>` (billboards that bend the scene behind them: heat haze, shock rings), `subEmitter <birth | death | collision> "<emitter id>" <count> [<inherit velocity>]` (up to 4: another emitter's particles born where this one's are born, die or bounce; one level deep) and `events <birth | death | collision>...` (og.ParticleEvent: its systems simulate in the tick). A sprite-mode emitter may draw from a texture array instead (`array "<id>" [<layers>] [off | life <cycles> | fps <n> | random]`: each particle shows a layer by its age, at a rate, or one at random for its life; one draw per array whatever the layers; `round true` fades each particle to the soft dot's round edge). `effect "<id>"` draws its billboards or mesh particles with an effect material (an `.ogt` of `type effect`: a main texture, gradient ramp, mask, noise erosion, flow map, fresnel and soft depth fade, each texture with its own tile, scroll, turn and polar coordinates; intensity, alpha, the uv offset, the erosion and eight custom numbers as a constant, a random range per particle or a curve over its life; an optional material shader whose surface_color hook runs last and reads effect_life(), effect_random(), effect_custom1() and effect_custom2()). Expressive lines: `speedOverLife`, `spinOverLife` and `rateOverTime` curves (<t> <value> pairs, against the velocity, the angular velocity and over each cycle against `rate`); `attractor <x> <y> <z> <strength> [<radius>]` (up to 4 points in the emitter's space that pull, or push when negative); `field curl <strength> [<frequency> <scroll>]` (divergence-free curl noise) or `field "<texture>" <strength> <size>` (a vector grid the cook bakes from an image N² wide and N high, N up to 16: pixel x + z·N, y from the bottom, rgb 0..1 as -1..1); `shape spline <x> <y> <z> ... [closed]` (2 to 8 Catmull-Rom points, emitted evenly along it and along its tangent); `inheritVelocity <fraction>` (of the emitter's own velocity, world space). Every one runs the same in compute and on the CPU path. The textures, array, mesh model, effect material and sub-emitters it names are loaded with it (a sub-emitter that fires its parent is refused); while the array's streaming group is not resident its systems draw nothing. Loaded once per path.

```ts
og.load.emitter(world: World, path: string): Result<ParticleEmitter>
```

| Parameter | Type | Optional | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `world` | `World` | no | The world whose renderer owns it. |
| `path` | `string` | no | The asset id, such as `fx/sparks.ogt`. |

**Returns** `Result<ParticleEmitter>`: Refused for a path not in the bundle, or a texture, texture array, model or sub-emitter it cannot load.
